verdict.rationale: OpenCode ships an official JS/TS SDK with type-safe client for programmatic control, plus a headless server mode (`opencode serve`) exposing an OpenAPI endpoint, confirmed both in docs and via a live openapi.json probe. This directly supports building custom integrations against official SDKs/APIs. Missing for 10: independent third-party developer testimonials specifically about building against the SDK (community evidence covers usage of the harness itself, not SDK-based integration building), and broader language SDK coverage beyond JS/TS.
